content: GPU floating-point non-associativity plus nondeterministic parallel work scheduling (e.g. atomic-based reductions) causes run-to-run bit differences even on identical hardware/inputs; root cause is variable operation ordering across invocations/subgroups, not the hardware itself. Determinism is achievable by fixing/serializing reduction order (avoid atomicAdd-style unordered accumulation) and pinning workgroup/dispatch structure so scheduling order is invariant.
